title: Remainder characterization of Euler liars
statement: For natural numbers $N$ and $A$, the numbers $A$ is an Euler liar for $N$ if and only if $\gcd(A,N)=1$ and the least nonnegative remainder of the Jacobi symbol $(A/N)$ upon division by $N$ equals the remainder of $A^{(N-1)/2}$ upon division by $N$.
